en.t: The flowers are in full bloom.

units.source_text: 但是，在他的素描中，花儿被抹杀了。

en.t: But in his sketch, the flowers had been erased.

units.source_text: 梅树作为风景画的近景，大得令人怀疑是个什么怪物。

en.t: As the foreground of the landscape painting, the plum tree was so large that one might suspect it was some kind of monster.
